general.descriptionTextModule: Generate a realistic demo catalogue, customers and orders.

options.title: What to generate
options.hint: Safe to run as often as you like. Existing data is reused rather than duplicated, and nothing is ever deleted.
options.channelsHelp: Leave empty to generate every channel.
options.perCategoryHelp: Raising this only adds products. Existing ones keep their names, numbers and IDs.
options.withMediaHelp: The first run downloads around 400 photographs and takes several minutes. Turn this off to seed without images.
options.withOrdersHelp: Adds customers and a year of order history, so the dashboard and order list have something to show.

status.title: Last run
status.idleBody: Choose your options above and select Generate.
status.runningBody: This runs in the background and needs an admin tab left open. You can leave this page; the result will be here when you come back.

notification.statusFailed: Could not read the generation status.
